course.title: English A2 → B1 · Everyday Communication
course.description: Khóa cầu nối sáu bài học giúp người học A2 sử dụng tiếng Anh tự tin hơn trong kế hoạch, thói quen, yêu cầu lịch sự và giải quyết vấn đề hằng ngày.

units.title: Plans, routines and healthy choices
units.objective: Nói về kế hoạch, thói quen và những thay đổi nhỏ trong đời sống bằng câu rõ ràng hơn.

units.title: Requests, choices and solutions
units.objective: Đưa ra yêu cầu lịch sự, so sánh lựa chọn và trình bày cách giải quyết một vấn đề nhỏ.

lessons.title: Making plans for the week
lessons.summary: Dùng present continuous, be going to và will để nói về kế hoạch trong tuần.
lessons.body: Plan a realistic week with a partner. Notice the difference between a fixed arrangement (I’m meeting…), an intention (I’m going to…) and a decision made now (I’ll…). Finish by making one clear invitation.
lessons.transcript:
Mia: Are you free on Thursday evening?
Jon: I’m meeting my cousin after work, but I’m free on Friday.
Mia: Great. I’m going to try the new food market. Would you like to come?
Jon: Yes, I’d love to. I’ll check the train times tonight.
lessons.source_attribution: Original LearnMate A2→B1 content pack, written for the graduation-project MVP.
lessons.license_name: Original project content; internal demo use

objectives: Nói về một lịch hẹn đã sắp xếp.
Phân biệt ý định và quyết định phát sinh trong lúc nói.
Mời bạn và xác nhận thời gian, địa điểm rõ ràng.

vocabulary.example: We arranged a meeting for Friday.
Are you available after six?
Can we reschedule the appointment?
I’ll check the train times tonight.

reading.title: Read the chat
reading.text:
Linh: I’m working from home on Tuesday, so I’m free at lunchtime.
Sam: I’m going to visit the library on Tuesday. Shall we study together?
Linh: I’d like to, but I have a dentist appointment at one.
Sam: No problem. I’ll reserve a table for Wednesday morning instead.

questions.prompt: When is Linh free at lunchtime?
Why can’t Linh study at one on Tuesday?

listening.title: Listen for the type of plan
listening.instructions: Nghe transcript hai lần. Gạch chân một câu là arrangement, một câu là intention và một câu là instant decision.

questions.prompt: What is Jon doing on Thursday?

practice.prompt: Choose: I ___ my manager at ten tomorrow. (meet / am meeting)
Choose: I’m tired. I think I ___ home early. (will go / am going)
Write one polite invitation using Would you like to…?
practice.answer: Open response; check a clear activity and time.

speaking.prompt: Invite a classmate to do something next week. Agree on a day, time and place, then change one detail politely.
success_criteria: Dùng ít nhất hai cấu trúc nói về tương lai
Phản hồi được khi kế hoạch thay đổi

writing.prompt: Write a 60–80 word message inviting a friend to an activity next week.
success_criteria: Có thời gian và địa điểm
Kết thúc bằng câu hỏi xác nhận

lessons.title: Small changes, better routines
lessons.summary: Đọc về những thay đổi nhỏ trong thói quen và dùng từ vựng để mô tả lối sống cân bằng.
lessons.body: Read about a student who changes one habit at a time. Identify the main idea, supporting details and useful words for frequency, food and rest. Then write one realistic change for your own week.
lessons.transcript: Nora used to skip breakfast when she was busy. Now she prepares fruit and yoghurt the night before. She also walks for twenty minutes after lunch. These changes are small, but she has more energy in the afternoon and sleeps better at night.
lessons.source_attribution: Original LearnMate A2→B1 content pack, written for the graduation-project MVP.
lessons.license_name: Original project content; internal demo use

objectives: Tìm ý chính và chi tiết hỗ trợ trong một đoạn đọc ngắn.
Dùng used to, hiện tại đơn và trạng từ tần suất để mô tả thói quen.
Viết một thay đổi nhỏ có thể thực hiện trong tuần này.

vocabulary.example: I used to skip breakfast on busy days.
A balanced meal can include vegetables and protein.
Walking after lunch is a healthy habit.
I have more energy in the afternoon.

reading.title: One change at a time
reading.text: Nora used to skip breakfast when she was busy. She thought saving ten minutes would help her finish more work, but she often felt tired before lunch. Now she prepares fruit and yoghurt the night before. She also walks for twenty minutes after lunch instead of checking her phone immediately. These changes are small, but Nora has more energy in the afternoon and sleeps better at night. She says the important point is not to change everything at once: a simple habit is easier to repeat.

questions.prompt: What does Nora do after lunch now?

options: A small repeatable change can improve a routine.
Breakfast is the only important meal.

listening.title: Listen for the before-and-after details
listening.instructions: Nghe transcript và ghi lại một thói quen cũ, một thói quen mới và một kết quả.

practice.prompt: Complete: I ___ play games late, but now I go to bed earlier. (used to / use to)
Complete: She ___ drinks water before class. (usually / is usually)
Rewrite with because: I prepare lunch the night before. Mornings are busy.
practice.answer: I prepare lunch the night before because mornings are busy.

reading: A small repeatable change can improve a routine.
practice: I prepare lunch the night before because mornings are busy.

speaking.prompt: Describe one habit you used to have and one small change you want to make. Explain why.

writing.prompt: Write 80–100 words about a small routine change. Include the old habit, the new habit and one expected result.
success_criteria: Dùng because hoặc so để nối ý
Có một kết quả cụ thể

lessons.title: Changing a plan politely
lessons.summary: Nghe/xem một cuộc hội thoại ngắn, nhận ra lý do đổi kế hoạch và đưa ra lời thay thế.
lessons.body: Watch the short original scene. A delayed bus changes two friends’ plan. Notice how they explain the problem, apologise briefly and suggest a new time instead of simply cancelling.
lessons.transcript:
Mai: I’m sorry, but I’m still on the bus. There’s heavy traffic near the bridge.
Leo: That’s okay. Do you know when you’ll arrive?
Mai: Maybe in thirty minutes. Could we meet at seven instead?
Leo: Seven works for me. I’ll wait outside the café.
Mai: Thanks. I’ll text you when I get off the bus.
lessons.source_attribution: Original LearnMate A2→B1 content pack and original recording script.
lessons.license_name: Original project content; project-owned video recording required

objectives: Nhận ra vấn đề và thời gian mới trong hội thoại.
Dùng lời xin lỗi, could we…? và I’ll… để đổi kế hoạch lịch sự.
Tóm tắt lại một cuộc hội thoại ngắn sau khi xem video.

vocabulary.example: There is heavy traffic near the bridge.
What time will you arrive?
Seven works for me.
I’ll call you when I get off the bus.

reading.title: A short message
reading.text: Hi Leo, I’m sorry, but the bus is delayed because of traffic. I may arrive at 7:00. Could we meet at the café then? I’ll send another message when I get off the bus. Thanks for understanding.

listening.title: Watch and listen
listening.instructions: Xem video/đọc transcript hai lần. Lần đầu tìm vấn đề; lần hai ghi lại thời gian mới và lời hứa cập nhật.

practice.prompt: Make this polite: Change the time to seven.
practice.answer: Could we meet at seven instead?

practice.prompt: Complete: I’m sorry, but I ___ arrive late. (may / am may)
Choose the best reply: ‘Seven works for me.’
practice.answer: Thanks. I’ll text you when I arrive.

practice: Could we meet at seven instead?
Thanks. I’ll text you when I arrive.

speaking.prompt: Role-play a changed plan: explain a delay, apologise, suggest a new time and confirm how you will update the other person.
success_criteria: Đưa ra thời gian thay thế

writing.prompt: Write a 50–70 word message to change an appointment because you are delayed.

lessons.title: Making polite requests
lessons.summary: Dùng Could you…?, Would you mind…? và I’d appreciate it if… trong tình huống học tập và công việc.
lessons.body: Watch the original office scene and practise asking for help without sounding too direct. Compare a direct request with a polite request, then write a short follow-up message.
lessons.transcript:
An: Could you send me the meeting notes, please?
Binh: Sure. Would you like them before lunch?
An: Yes, please. I’d appreciate it if you could include the action points.
Binh: No problem. I’ll send them by eleven.

lessons.license_name: Original project content; project-owned video recording required

objectives: Chuyển một yêu cầu trực tiếp thành yêu cầu lịch sự.
Hỏi lại deadline và xác nhận việc cần làm.
Viết tin nhắn follow-up ngắn và rõ ràng.

reading.title: A helpful email
reading.text: Hi Thu, Could you check the first page of my report when you have time? I’d appreciate it if you could look at the introduction and tell me whether the main idea is clear. There is no rush, but feedback before Friday would be very helpful. Thanks, Nam.

questions.prompt: What does Nam ask Thu to check?
options: The first page of his report

lessons.title: Comparing everyday options
lessons.summary: So sánh hai lựa chọn, nêu lý do và đưa ra khuyến nghị ngắn.
lessons.body: Compare two ways to travel to work or school. Use comparative forms, because, although and in my view to move from separate sentences to a connected recommendation.
lessons.transcript: The bus is cheaper than the train, but it is usually slower. The train is more reliable during the morning rush hour. Although the ticket costs more, it may be a better choice when arriving on time is important.
lessons.source_attribution: Original LearnMate A2→B1 content pack, written for the graduation-project MVP.
lessons.license_name: Original project content; internal demo use

objectives: Dùng comparative adjectives để so sánh hai lựa chọn.
Nối ưu điểm và hạn chế bằng but, although và because.
Viết một khuyến nghị có lý do cụ thể.

vocabulary.example: The train is more reliable in the morning.
Traffic is heavy during rush hour.
The bus stop is more convenient for me.
I recommend the train for an early meeting.

reading.title: Bus or train?
reading.text: The bus from Green Street is cheaper and stops close to Mai’s home. However, it can be slow during rush hour. The train costs more, but it is faster and more reliable. Mai usually takes the bus when she has time. When she has an important morning meeting, she chooses the train because arriving on time matters more than saving a little money.

questions.prompt: What is one advantage of the bus?
When does Mai choose the train?
options: When she wants to save money
When she has an important morning meeting
When the bus stop is close
When she is not in a hurry

questions.prompt: Why does she choose the train then?
options: The train is more comfortable at night.

listening.title: Listen for the recommendation
listening.instructions: Nghe transcript và ghi lại lựa chọn nào rẻ hơn, lựa chọn nào đáng tin cậy hơn và khi nào nên chọn tàu.

questions.prompt: Which option may be better when time matters?

practice.prompt: Complete: The train is ___ (fast) than the bus.
Join with although: The ticket costs more. The train is reliable.
practice.answer: Although the ticket costs more, the train is reliable.

practice.prompt: Choose: I recommend the bus ___ it is cheaper. (because / although)

reading: When she has an important morning meeting
practice: Although the ticket costs more, the train is reliable.

success_criteria: Dùng ít nhất hai tính từ so sánh

writing.prompt: Write 100–120 words recommending one of two transport options to a friend.
success_criteria: Có mở bài nêu hai lựa chọn

lessons.title: Solving a small problem
lessons.summary: Mô tả vấn đề, đề xuất giải pháp và thống nhất bước tiếp theo trong một tình huống đời thường.
lessons.body: Watch the original scene in which a learner cannot open a shared document. Listen for the problem, the proposed solution and the final confirmation. Then solve a similar problem with a partner.
lessons.transcript:
Lan: I can’t open the shared document. It says I need permission.
Minh: Let me check the link. It looks like the old version.
Lan: Should I send you my email again?
Minh: Yes, please. I’ll update the permission and send a new link.
Lan: Great. I’ll try it now and tell you if it works.
lessons.source_attribution: Original LearnMate A2→B1 content pack and original recording script.
lessons.license_name: Original project content; project-owned video recording required

objectives: Mô tả một vấn đề kỹ thuật/đời thường bằng câu ngắn rõ ràng.
Đề xuất giải pháp với Let me…, Should I…? và I’ll… .
Xác nhận kết quả và bước tiếp theo.

vocabulary.example: The document says I need permission.
We work in a shared document.
This looks like the old version.
I’ll update the permission.

reading.title: A simple solution
reading.text: When Bao could not join the online class, he first checked his internet connection. The connection was fine, so he closed the app and opened it again. The problem continued. His teacher sent a new meeting link, and Bao joined successfully. He wrote the new link in his notebook so he could find it later.

options: The teacher sent a new link.

listening.title: Watch the problem-solving steps
listening.instructions: Ghi lại: vấn đề là gì, Minh kiểm tra gì, Lan cần gửi lại thông tin nào và kết quả mong đợi.

Choose: ___ I send you the file again? (Should / Am)
